culprit_citations.quoted_text: Total investments, at fair value (amortized cost of $ 1,490,018,182 and $ 1,329,540,850 ) | 1,480,958,078 | 1,311,120,584

findings.detail: The position sum exceeds the companyfacts and schedule investment fair-value anchor by 33,924,769, exactly the schedule's Total Cash Equivalents amount.

rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation shows the filing balance sheet total investments and the schedule TOTAL INVESTMENTS fair value are both 1,480,958,078, matching the companyfacts_fv anchor. The extracted fair-value position sum is 1,514,882,847, an overshoot of 33,924,769. The source schedule separately reports Total Cash Equivalents of 33,924,769 below TOTAL INVESTMENTS, so the residual is explained by cash-equivalent rows being included in the extracted holdings sum even though they are outside the investment fair-value anchor.
